editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: Five stanzas as printed on pp. 221-222 under the title 'A Christmas Carol'; indentation of alternate lines is not reproduced. Punctuation follows the scan where it differs from the Wikisource transcription ('Throng'd the air,' with a comma); the end of 'May have gathered there' is faint and was read as a period.
